name: git-commit
description: Craft a conventional-commit message from the diff and run the commit safely: review before staging, no blind `git add .`, multiline bodies via -F, branch check first.

interface.shortDescription: Safe conventional commits from the diff.
interface.longDescription: Derives a conventional-commit message from the actual diff and runs the commit safely — reviewing before staging, banning blind `git add .`, writing multiline bodies via -F, keeping unwanted trailers out, and checking the branch first. Covers the full local flow through verify and optional amend; stops before push.
